elements_selected.content: Implement BLAKE3 hashing for all leaf nodes and compute file and vault Merkle roots per §4.1-4.2 and §4.6. Leaf hashing: ContentHash = BLAKE3(type_tag_byte ‖ normalised_content_bytes) for all non-SPL leaves. The type_tag_byte is a unique sentinel per LeafType variant (e.g., Heading=0x01, Paragraph=0x02, etc.). File Merkle root: ContentHash = BLAKE3(leaf1_hash ‖ leaf2_hash ‖ … ‖ leafN_hash) in document order. Vault root: ContentHash = BLAKE3(file1_hash ‖ file2_hash ‖ … ‖ fileM_hash) sorted by canonical relative path (UTF-8 lexicographic, forward-slash normalised) per §4.6. Store per-file root in FileMerkle::root_hash. Store vault root in the cache index. Expose compute_leaf_hash, compute_file_root, compute_vault_root as testable functions in a new src/merkle.rs module (or inline in scanner.rs). SPL leaf hashing is handled separately in task-spl-dual-hashing — leave SplBlock leaves with a placeholder sentinel hash for now.
